about_the_game:
The empress of the Everlasting Empire stars in her own solo campaign within Ark's Wonder Dungeon! Hunting for her lost dogs, Hades and Thanatos, she ends up straying far off her intended path! The Evil Empress takes the detour with grace and wreaks havoc as a dominating glass cannon with no backup.

It isn't just her that's unique, though! Several aspects of the dungeon change to accommodate its unexpected guest: frogs, merchants, and worst of all, clowns...

By obtaining the empress' achievements, you'll unlock several strong equips and interactive structures for the rest of the characters to utilize! These tools may even allow you to take on several new DLC exclusive monsters in order to claim their destructive power as your own...

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains visualizations of fantasy gore, alcohol, and drugs. It also contains occasional allusions to suicide. Viewer discretion is advised.
